description: The 51 lib parameter annotations that pick a clause become guards (e.g. Kernel 'def negate(x :: integer)' -> 'def negate(x) when is_integer(x)'); File.close's declaration-only 'handle :: t' is carried by its @spec. Kernel's type predicates (is_integer, is_float, is_binary, is_list, is_map, is_atom, is_tuple, is_boolean, is_nil, is_pid, is_reference) are NOT changed here (fz-ep5 type-predicate ticket). Prediction: no output or pin change, since a guard type test and a parameter annotation build the same Region::Type row; a guard referencing a Kernel predicate from inside Kernel must not create a cycle - report if it does. Acceptance: full gate green, no pin rise.
title: lib picks clauses with guards and declares types with @spec, not '::'
